releaseName: Tell career evidence and profile apart
summary: One sprint since Folders on Home (milestone 77). Career evidence and Career profile now read as one pipeline. Home shows a "Your career" panel with two numbered steps joined by a "builds" arrow; its buttons say "Add or manage documents" and "Review facts" (#2297). Both career pages share numbered tabs, 1 Career evidence and 2 Career profile, with an Applications link (#2298). The profile page asks "Looking to add or replace a CV?" and links to Career evidence, refusing a dropped file there; the evidence page links to Career profile for facts (#2299). Shared screens only, so the desktop client changes too. No data or model change.
knownLimitations: Names are unchanged. A file dropped on the Career profile page is not carried to Career evidence; the person adds it there. Facts do not yet link to the document they came from.
